tools.name: start_review
tools.description: Start a full propose-verify code review of a Godot project, in the background. Returns a task_id immediately — poll with get_review_result. Only one review per project runs at a time; a second call while one is running raises a conflict error.

tools.name: get_review_result
tools.description: Poll a review task started by start_review. running → {status: running, elapsed_s}; done → {status: done, summary, report_json, report_md}; failed → {status: failed, error}. Unknown task_id raises an error.

tools.name: get_latest_report
tools.description: Return the newest stored review report for a project (from a previous run), without running anything. {status: no_reports} when none exist.

tools.name: lookup_symbol
tools.description: Find where a class, autoload, script, signal, method or scene node is declared. Pure index scan — never calls an LLM. Returns {query, hits}.

tools.name: ask_codebase
tools.description: Answer a natural-language question about the codebase via index RAG: top-k retrieval over the project index, then an LLM answer with file:line citations. Without an API key it degrades honestly to a structured summary of the retrieved entries (llm_used=False).

tools.name: health
tools.description: Server self-check: which LLM providers have API keys configured, whether the default project exists, and whether the index cache is warm.
